topic: For an established consumer software team shipping an AI-prototyped MVP within 90 days, under what conditions does moving fast with AI-generated code help versus hurt the company — and through what specific pathways does prototype code convert into either validated learning or terminal maintenance burden? Map the explicit tug-of-war between Product (feature velocity), Engineering (code stability), and Finance (growth per dollar) incentives. The product in mind is a low risk consumer product from an established company (not a startup) with no agentic or other AI features.
name: rerun-consumer-product-post-changes
